name: Descript
tagline: Edit video and audio by editing text
description: Descript is a video and audio editor with AI features, priced per person with media hours and AI credits.
features: Media hours and AI credits per month
strengths: Free plan with no card required
limitations: The page shows two prices per plan without saying which is the annual one

plans.name: Hobbyist
highlights: 10 media hours and 400 AI credits per month
plans.note: Two prices are shown ($16 and $24 per person per month) but the page does not label which is annual
limits: 10 media hours and 400 AI credits per month

highlights: 30 media hours and 800 AI credits per month
Team of up to 3, billed separately
plans.note: Two prices are shown ($24 and $35 per person per month) but the page does not label which is annual
limits: 30 media hours and 800 AI credits per month

plans.name: Business

Team of up to 5, billed separately

free.details: 60 minutes of media per month and 100 one-time AI credits. No credit card needed.

notes: The page says annual billing saves up to 35% over monthly, but does not map each price to a billing option.

verification.notes: Product active. The page opened on the Annual view ('Saving up to 35% with annual billing') and shows two figures per plan: Hobbyist $16 and $24, Creator $24 and $35, Business $50 and $65 per person/month. The Monthly view could not be toggled, so the page text does not label which figure is which; the lower figure is most likely the annual price. Plan allowances read: Hobbyist 10 media hours and 400 AI credits per month, Creator 30 hours and 800 credits, Business 40 hours and 1,500 credits.

profile.headline: Edit video and audio by editing the transcript

capabilities.title: Edit by deleting words
capabilities.text: Delete a word in the transcript and the matching footage goes with it; move a sentence and the video moves too.

capabilities.title: Let the AI assistant do a first cut
capabilities.text: Underlord can turn a raw recording into a tight cut or handle specific editing tasks on request.

capabilities.title: Clean up the sound and the take
capabilities.text: Studio Sound, Edit for Clarity, Remove Filler Words and Remove Retakes are listed on the site.

capabilities.title: Create content from a recording
capabilities.text: Create Clips, Captions, Show notes, YouTube descriptions and Translation are listed.

featureCards.name: Underlord
featureCards.text: An AI assistant for editing tasks.

featureCards.name: Transcription
featureCards.text: Automatic transcripts that you edit like text.

featureCards.name: Podcasting
featureCards.text: Multitrack audio editing handled like editing text.

featureCards.name: Screen recorder and Rooms
featureCards.text: Record your screen, or record remotely with other people.

featureCards.name: AI speech and Avatars
featureCards.text: Voice cloning or stock AI voices, and AI Avatars.

featureCards.name: API and MCP
featureCards.text: Edit through code or from inside an AI assistant.

audienceDetail.text: Text-based editing makes cutting audio and video approachable, including for beginners.
The site names marketing, sales and sales enablement.
Learning and development, customer success and customer support teams are named.
The site lists enterprises such as Amazon, Canva and Salesforce among its customers.

scenarios.title: Marketing videos and product demos
scenarios.text: Cut a recording down by editing its text.

scenarios.title: Webinar recordings
scenarios.text: Remove filler words and retakes, then create clips.

scenarios.title: Tutorials and educational videos
scenarios.text: Record your screen and tidy the result from the transcript.

scenarios.title: Case studies
scenarios.text: Turn a recorded interview into a finished video with captions.

gettingStarted.text: Create an account at web.descript.com; the site says there is a free plan with no credit card.
Drop in video, audio or a recording such as a Zoom call.
Descript transcribes it, and editing the words edits the video.
Use the timeline when you need more control.

keyFeature: Edit video and audio by editing the text
